tagline: Break the flat → registration → bank loop
housingAlert: You need a landlord's confirmation of move-in (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung) to register. Make sure your landlord or main tenant will sign it before you agree to a sublet.
Never transfer a deposit before viewing and signing. Be wary of landlords who are 'abroad'.
Temporary rooms without registration permission can block the Anmeldung and everything after it.

tasks.title: Health insurance (EHIC)
tasks.description: EU citizens use the European Health Insurance Card for medically necessary care during a temporary stay. Free, requested from your own insurer before leaving.
steps: Request the EHIC before you travel
tasks.officialSourceName: Your Europe – Health cover for temporary stays

tasks.title: Accommodation with move-in confirmation
tasks.description: Step 1 of the loop. To register your address you need a valid ID and the landlord's confirmation of move-in (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung). Without a flat that allows registration, you cannot register, and the bank account usually comes after registration.
steps: Confirm the landlord will sign the Wohnungsgeberbestätigung
Get the signed confirmation on move-in day
tasks.warning: No Wohnungsgeberbestätigung = no Anmeldung. Check before you sign.

tasks.title: Address registration
tasks.description: Step 2 of the loop. Register within 14 days of moving in (the federal law says within two weeks). It is free. You can register online at wohnsitzanmeldung.gov.de (main residence only) or in person at a Bürgerbüro. After registration, the registration office notifies the broadcasting-fee service.
steps: Register online or book a Bürgerbüro appointment
Bring ID and the landlord's confirmation

tasks.title: Bank account
tasks.description: Step 3 of the loop. Consumers lawfully resident in the EU who have no payment account in Germany have a right to a basic account (Basiskonto). The bank must decide on a complete application within 10 business days; rejections can be challenged at BaFin free of charge. Banks often ask for your registration certificate.
steps: If refused, use the BaFin procedure
tasks.todo: TODO: verify which banks require the Meldebescheinigung (not stated on the BaFin page).
tasks.cost: Banks may charge only reasonable fees (§ 41 ZKG)

tasks.title: Broadcasting fee
tasks.description: 18.36 € per month per dwelling ('one dwelling – one fee'). Erasmus students living in their own dwelling are in principle required to pay; exemptions are limited. The registration office tells the fee service when you register, and they write to you. If you share a flat, only one person pays.
documentsNeeded: Contribution number (Beitragsnummer) if your flat already has one
steps: Check whether your flat already pays
Register or link to the existing contribution account

tasks.title: Before you leave: deregister your address
tasks.description: Deregistering when you move out is also due within two weeks, and you can do it up to one week before you leave.
steps: Deregister up to one week before departure
tasks.deadline: Within two weeks of moving out

tasks.title: Before you leave: stop the broadcasting fee
tasks.description: Students who forget this keep receiving payment requests after going home. You deregister the dwelling with your 9-digit Beitragsnummer and can attach proof (e.g. the Abmeldung certificate).
steps: Enter your Beitragsnummer and attach the Abmeldung
